blocks.text: Zone 300 is the essential wireless headset with great audio quality for work and downtime. Move freely about your home or office and stay reliably connected with multipoint Bluetooth, up to 30 meters away. Meet with anyone on your preferred calling platform. Dual noise-canceling mics on the extended mic boom suppress background sound and allow others to hear you clearly. Enhanced speakers mean you can also hear just as well. With its plastic parts made with a minimum of 55% recycled plastic*, Zone 300 is a choice you’ll feel good about. *Excluding printed wiring assembly (PWA), cables, and packaging.

items: Download and install LogiTune for access to enhanced features and firmware updates: Customize your headset’s firmware, adjust sidetone, mic level, and EQ for a personalized audio experience

items.label: Headset With Noise-Canceling Mic
items.value: Dual beamforming mics on the extended boom with noise-canceling algorithms suppress background noise in homes and shared workspaces for clear conversations

items.label: Impressive Audio
items.value: Embedded 30 mm dynamic audio drivers with customized fine-tuned diaphragm patterns to deliver clear audio for calls and other listening options

items.label: Freedom to Move
items.value: Move freely about your home or office with this Bluetooth headset with microphone; wireless range of up to 30 m (98 ft) (2); seamlessly switch between computer and phone

items.label: All-Day Usage
items.value: Get all-day battery life; up to 20 hours of listening time and 16 hours of talk time on a full charge; add up to 1 hour of talk time with a 5 min quick charge (3)

items.label: Extra Comfort
items.value: The comfortable, lightweight design (just 122 grams or 4.3 oz), enlarged earpads, and padded headband of this Logitech wireless headset make all-day use possible

items.label: Replace Your Earpads as Needed
items.value: Replaceable earpads extend the life of the headset (available for purchase separately)

items: The Logitech Zone 300 Bluetooth Wireless Headset is certified carbon neutral and includes certified post-consumer recycled plastic (Graphite: 55%, Off-white and Rose: 42%)(4)
